verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (brand, can, ribbon, headline, CTA) with the CTA vertically centred, but the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an illegible mark inside a dark planet circle, the can is tiny, and there is a dead gap between the can and the ribbon, which sits awkwardly on the planet. B runs the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon off the bottom-left canvas edge, crams the can and logo into the top-left corner, and wraps the legal text into a 3-line block under the CTA that is jammed against the bottom edge, so the right-hand column is top-heavy and cramped.
